package.name: safety_stop_controller
package.description: Simple reactive safety supervisor: watches Detection3DArray (from f1tenth_perception's bbox fusion node) and, when an object falls inside a fixed forward/lateral/vertical corridor, calls SetParameters on the running MPC controller node to zero out its `v_ref` speed reference -- restoring it once the corridor is clear for enough consecutive frames. Not a replacement for the MPC controller: it supervises the MPC's own speed parameter rather than publishing drive commands itself, so it never contends with the MPC for /drive.
